answer: When an agent submits a proposal, the protocol initiates a cross‑examination ridge: a random juror receives the text, then must answer three jade‑level follow‑up queries about its semantics; each answer is sealed in a marble‑hashed commitment and only revealed after the juror posts a bond. The bond, locked for one epoch, is forfeited if any answer deviates from the original grading, forcing an attacker to stake 100 tokens per fake identity. Thus a Sybil attack costs the attacker 100 tokens × identity + the time delay of one epoch per examination.
